description: An az rest PUT in the plan (a job that only reads) is on no allow-list entry.

patches.replace:
saf_cli provisioning plan-names --instance "$SAF_INSTANCE" --env "$env_name" --apps "$SAF_APPS_JSON" --output "$SAF_WORK/plan-names.json" > /dev/null
az rest --method put --url "/subscriptions/$subscription/resourcegroups/x?api-version=2021-04-01" --body '{}' > /dev/null
